name: Conventions: sidebar → decide on candidates → create the skill → Skills Lab
description: Reaches /repos/:repoId/conventions through the SKILLS LAB sidebar entry (which is also the only coverage the vendored nav item has), rejects one candidate, accepts the rest with the bulk button, then opens the create-skill modal and confirms the generated skill lands in the Skills Lab. Only decisions are exercised — the flow never presses Run extraction / Re-scan, because that is the one button on this screen that calls a model, and flows here run key-free. PRECONDITION: the seeded database must already contain grounded convention candidates for acme/payments-api (at least two, all pending); without them the screen renders its empty state and this flow fails at the first card assertion. Rejecting before the bulk accept is deliberate: 'Select all' only touches PENDING rows, so it leaves the rejected one rejected, which is what gives us one of each at the same time from first-match-only text locators.
